name: task-square
operation: spawn a task computing signed i32 x*x, join it, propagate a task failure, and return Ok(square)
input: one signed 32-bit integer in the bounded cases below
output: Ok(square) on success; Err(TaskError::Failed) for a task failure
concurrency: the square computation runs in a separate task; its completion is observed by join before output; scheduling order and latency are unspecified
ownership: the task receives a copied i32 input; no shared mutable state, I/O, or external side effects
limits: inputs are bounded so x*x fits i32; overflow and induced task failure are outside executable cases
